title.ur: Musalman safai ka khayal rakhta hai

intro.en: Mary and Salma talk about three kinds of cleanliness: the body, the clothes and the heart. Notice the phrase «عَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِم أَنْ …» (every Muslim must …).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Mary aur Salma safai ki teen qismon par baat karti hain: jism, kapde aur dil. Dhyan dein: «عَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِم أَنْ …» (har Musalman par lazim hai ke …).
intro.ar: ماري وَسَلْمى تَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنْ ثَلاثَةِ أَنْواعٍ مِنَ النَّظافَةِ: نَظافَةِ الجِسْمِ وَالثِّيابِ وَالقَلْبِ. اِنْتَبِهْ إِلى عِبارَةِ «عَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ أَنْ ...».

dialogue.ar: رائِحَةُ عِطْرِكِ جَميلَةٌ جِدّاً اليَوْمَ يا سَلْمى، فَما اسْمُهُ؟
dialogue.tr: rāʾiḥatu ʿiṭriki jamīlatun jiddan al-yawma yā salmā, famā smuh?
dialogue.en: Your perfume smells very nice today, Salma, so what is it called?
dialogue.ur: Salma, aaj tumhare itr ki khushboo bohat achhi hai, iska naam kya hai?

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً يا ماري، إِنَّهُ هَدِيَّةٌ مِنْ أُمّي.
dialogue.tr: shukran yā mārī, innahu hadiyyatun min ummī
dialogue.en: Thank you, Mary, it is a gift from my mother.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya Mary, ye meri ammi ka tohfa hai.

dialogue.ar: ما سِرُّ اهْتِمامِكِ الكَبيرِ بِالنَّظافَةِ يا سَلْمى؟
dialogue.tr: mā sirru htimāmiki l-kabīri bin-naẓāfati yā salmā?
dialogue.en: What is the secret of your great interest in cleanliness, Salma?
dialogue.ur: Salma, safai mein tumhari itni dilchaspi ka raaz kya hai?

dialogue.ar: هَذا لِأَنَّ دِيني يَحُثُّني عَلى ذَلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā liʾanna dīnī yaḥuththunī ʿalā dhālika
dialogue.en: That is because my religion urges me to do so.
dialogue.ur: Wo is liye ke mera deen mujhe isi ki targheeb deta hai.

dialogue.ar: أَهَذا حالُ المُسْلِمينَ كُلِّهِمْ؟
dialogue.tr: ahadhā ḥālu l-muslimīna kullihim?
dialogue.en: Is this the case of all Muslims?
dialogue.ur: Kya tamam musalmanon ka yahi haal hai?

dialogue.ar: السَّبَبُ أَنَّ عَلى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّأَ لِلصَّلاةِ وَيَغْتَسِلَ وَيَتَطَهَّرَ، فَالنَّظافَةُ جُزْءٌ مِنْ حَياتِنا.
dialogue.tr: as-sababu anna ʿalā kulli muslimin an yatawaḍḍaʾa liṣ-ṣalāti wayaghtasila wayataṭahhar, fan-naẓāfatu juzʾun min ḥaytinā
dialogue.en: The reason is that every Muslim must make wudu for prayer, wash and purify himself, for cleanliness is part of our life.
dialogue.ur: Wajah ye hai ke har musalman par lazim hai ke namaz ke liye wuzu kare, ghusl kare aur paak rahe, kyunke safai hamari zindagi ka hissa hai.

dialogue.ar: هَذا جَميلٌ، وَلَكِنْ هَلْ يَهْتَمُّ المُسْلِمُ بِمَلْبَسِهِ كَما يَهْتَمُّ بِجِسْمِهِ؟
dialogue.tr: hādhā jamīl, walakin hal yahtammu al-muslimu bimalbasihi kamā yahtammu bijismih?
dialogue.en: That is nice, but does a Muslim care about his clothing as he cares about his body?
dialogue.ur: Ye achhi baat hai, lekin kya musalman apne libaas ka bhi utna khayal rakhta hai jitna apne jism ka?

dialogue.ar: المُسْلِمُ يُحِبُّ المَلْبَسَ النَّظيفَ، فَثِيابُهُ نَظيفَةٌ دائِماً.
dialogue.tr: al-muslimu yuḥibbu al-malbasa n-naẓīf, fathībuhu naẓīfatun dāʾiman
dialogue.en: A Muslim loves clean clothing, so his clothes are always clean.
dialogue.ur: Musalman saaf libaas pasand karta hai, isliye uske kapde hamesha saaf hote hain.

dialogue.ar: يَبْدو أَنَّ النَّظافَةَ شَيْءٌ كَبيرٌ في دينِكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: yabdū anna an-naẓāfata shayʾun kabīrun fī dīnikum
dialogue.en: It seems that cleanliness is a big thing in your religion.
dialogue.ur: Lagta hai aapke deen mein safai ki bohat badi ahmiyat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهُناكَ نَوْعٌ آخَرُ لا نَراهُ بِالعَيْنِ.
dialogue.tr: wahunāka nawʿun ʾākharu lā narāhu bil-ʿayn
dialogue.en: And there is another kind that we cannot see with the eye.
dialogue.ur: Aur ek aur qisam bhi hai jo hum aankh se nahin dekh sakte.

dialogue.ar: وَما هُوَ هَذا النَّوْعُ؟
dialogue.tr: wamā huwa hādhā n-nawʿ?
dialogue.en: And what is this kind?
dialogue.ur: Wo kaun si qisam hai?

dialogue.ar: إِنَّها أَنْ يَكونَ المُسْلِمُ نَظيفَ القَلْبِ مِنَ الحِقْدِ وَالحَسَدِ.
dialogue.tr: innahā an yakūna l-muslimu naẓīfa l-qalbi mina l-ḥiqdi wal-ḥasad
dialogue.en: It is that a Muslim should be clean of heart, free of hatred and envy.
dialogue.ur: Ye ke musalman dil ka saaf ho, kina aur hasad se paak.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ يَكونُ ذَلِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa yakūnu dhālika?
dialogue.en: How is that?
dialogue.ur: Wo kaise hota hai?

dialogue.ar: يَعْني أَنْ يَخْلُوَ قَلْبُهُ مِنَ الكُرْهِ، وَأَنْ يُريدَ لِلْآخَرينَ الخَيْرَ الَّذي يُريدُهُ لِنَفْسِهِ.
dialogue.tr: yaʿnī an yakhluwa qalbuhu mina l-kurh, waʾan yurīda lil-ʾākharīna l-khayra lladhī yurīduhu linafsih
dialogue.en: It means that his heart is free of ill will, and that he wants for others the good he wants for himself.
dialogue.ur: Matlab ye ke uska dil bughz se khali ho, aur wo doosron ke liye wahi bhalai chahe jo apne liye chahta hai.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً يا سَلْمى، تَعَلَّمْتُ مِنْكِ اليَوْمَ شَيْئاً جَديداً.
dialogue.tr: shukran yā salmā, taʿallamtu minki l-yawma shayʾan jadīdan
dialogue.en: Thank you, Salma, I learned something new from you today.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya Salma, aaj maine tum se ek nayi baat seekhi.

dialogue.ar: العَفْوُ يا عَزيزَتي، إِلى اللِّقاءِ غَداً بِإِذْنِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿafwu yā ʿazīzatī, ilā l-liqāʾi ghadan biʾidhni llāh
dialogue.en: You are welcome, dear; see you tomorrow, by Allah's leave.
dialogue.ur: Koi baat nahin pyari, Allah ke izn se kal milenge.

q.en: What are the three kinds of cleanliness Salma mentions?
q.ur: Salma safai ki kaun si teen qismein batati hai?
q.ar: ما أَنْواعُ النَّظافَةِ الثَّلاثَةُ الَّتي تَذْكُرُها سَلْمى؟

q.ur: «يَتَوَضَّأُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: According to Salma, why does a Muslim care about cleanliness?
q.ur: Salma ke mutabiq musalman safai ka khayal kyun rakhta hai?
q.ar: لِماذا يَهْتَمُّ المُسْلِمُ بِالنَّظافَةِ في رَأْيِ سَلْمى؟

q.ur: «نَظيفُ القَلْبِ» kis ki sifat hai?

options: Someone whose heart is free of ill will and who wants for others the good he wants for himself
options_ar: مَنْ يَخْلو قَلْبُهُ مِنَ الكُرْهِ وَيُريدُ لِلْآخَرينَ الخَيْرَ

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "libaas" ka matlab deta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما يَلْبَسُهُ الإِنْسانُ؟

title.ur: Ra ko moti aur patli parhna

intro.en: The letter ر can be pronounced heavy (مُفَخَّمَة) or light (مُرَقَّقَة). With a kasra it is light: رِحال. With a fatha or damma it is heavy: رَجُل، رُسُل. A silent ر depends on the vowel before it.
intro.ur: Harf ر kabhi moti (مُفَخَّمَة) aur kabhi patli (مُرَقَّقَة) parha jata hai. Zer ke saath patli: رِحال. Zabar ya pesh ke saath moti: رَجُل، رُسُل. Sakin ر ka faisla us se pehle wali harkat se hota hai.
intro.ar: الرّاءُ تَكونُ مُفَخَّمَةً أَوْ مُرَقَّقَةً. مَعَ الكَسْرَةِ تُرَقَّقُ مِثْلَ: رِحال. وَمَعَ الفَتْحَةِ أَوِ الضَّمَّةِ تُفَخَّمُ مِثْلَ: رَجُل، رُسُل. وَالرّاءُ السّاكِنَةُ يَتْبَعُ حُكْمُها الحَرَكَةَ الَّتي قَبْلَها.

q.en: How is a ر with a kasra pronounced?
q.ur: Zer wali ر kaise parhi jati hai?

q.en: Which word has a heavy ر?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein moti ر hai?

q.en: Which word has a light ر?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein patli ر hai?

q.en: A silent ر after a damma (as in غُرْفَة) is:
q.ur: Pesh ke baad sakin ر (jaise غُرْفَة) hoti hai:
q.ar: الرّاءُ السّاكِنَةُ بَعْدَ ضَمَّةٍ (كَما في «غُرْفَة») تُنْطَقُ:

intro.en: Relative pronouns mean "who / which / that". الَّذي = masculine singular; الَّتي = feminine singular (and broken plurals of things); اللَّذانِ / اللَّتانِ = dual (m / f); الَّذينَ = masculine plural; اللَّاتي / اللائي = feminine plural. Example: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذي أَنْزَلَ عَلى عَبْدِهِ الكِتابَ.
intro.ur: Ism-e-mausool ka matlab "jo / jis ne". الَّذي = ek mard (mufrad muzakkar); الَّتي = ek aurat (aur beaql cheezon ki jama); اللَّذانِ / اللَّتانِ = tasniya (mard / aurat); الَّذينَ = mardon ki jama; اللَّاتي / اللائي = aurton ki jama. Misaal: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذي أَنْزَلَ عَلى عَبْدِهِ الكِتابَ.
intro.ar: الأَسْماءُ المَوْصولَةُ: الَّذي لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُذَكَّرِ، الَّتي لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُؤَنَّثِ، اللَّذانِ وَاللَّتانِ لِلْمُثَنّى، الَّذينَ لِجَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ، اللّاتي وَاللّائي لِجَمْعِ المُؤَنَّثِ. مِثالٌ: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذي أَنْزَلَ عَلى عَبْدِهِ الكِتابَ.

q.en: Which relative pronoun is for a masculine singular noun?
q.ur: Mufrad muzakkar ke liye kaun sa ism-e-mausool hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ اسْمٍ مَوْصولٍ نَسْتَعْمِلُهُ لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُذَكَّرِ؟

q.ur: Do auraton ke liye kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ اسْمٍ مَوْصولٍ نَسْتَعْمِلُهُ لِلْمُثَنّى المُؤَنَّثِ (امْرَأَتَيْنِ)؟

q.en: Which is for a group of males?
q.ur: Mardon ki jama ke liye kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ اسْمٍ مَوْصولٍ نَسْتَعْمِلُهُ لِجَماعَةِ الذُّكورِ؟

q.ur: Mukammal karein: هذانِ الطّالِبانِ ___ فازا بالجائِزَةِ.

intro.en: Listen to a dialogue about a dirty neighbourhood and answer the questions (why Amir wants to leave, why the residents will meet, where they put rubbish, how often they will clean). Then ask your partner about cleanliness habits using كَمْ مَرَّة and مَتى.
intro.ur: Mohalle ke ganda hone par ek mukaalma suniye aur sawalon ke jawab dein. Phir apne saathi se safai ki aadaton ke baare mein كَمْ مَرَّة (kitni baar) aur مَتى (kab) se sawal poochhein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى حِوارٍ عَنْ حَيٍّ سَكَنِيٍّ مُتَّسِخٍ وَأَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ: لِماذا يُريدُ أَميرٌ أَنْ يَنْتَقِلَ، وَلِماذا سَيَجْتَمِعُ السُّكّانُ، وَأَيْنَ يَضَعونَ القُمامَةَ، وَكَمْ مَرَّةً سَيُنَظِّفونَ. ثُمَّ اسْأَلْ زَميلَكَ عَنْ عاداتِ النَّظافَةِ بِـ«كَمْ مَرَّةً» وَ«مَتى».

q.ur: «كَمْ مَرَّةً تُنَظِّفُ أَسْنانَكَ؟» kis ke baare mein hai?
q.ar: ماذا نَسْأَلُ بِقَوْلِنا «كَمْ مَرَّةً تُنَظِّفُ أَسْنانَكَ؟»

options: How many times you clean your teeth

q.ur: «الأَوْساخُ» ka matlab?
«مَتى يَتَوَضَّأُ المُسْلِمُ؟» poochta hai:

options: When does a Muslim make wudu?

q.ur: «يُنَظِّفُ» ka matlab:

intro.en: A reading passage about how Islam calls to cleanliness and purity: wudu, ghusl, and clean clothes. It quotes verses of the Qur'an.
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matn ke Islam safai aur paaki ki taraf kaise bulata hai: wuzu, ghusl aur saaf kapde. Is mein Quran ki ayaat aayi hain.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ عَنْ دَعْوَةِ الإِسْلامِ إِلى النَّظافَةِ وَالطَّهارَةِ: الوُضوءُ وَالغُسْلُ وَالثِّيابُ النَّظيفَةُ. يَذْكُرُ النَّصُّ آياتٍ مِنَ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ.

dialogue.ar: تَدْعو تَعالِيمُ الإِسْلامِ كُلَّ مُسْلِمٍ إِلى أَنْ يَكونَ نَظيفاً طاهِراً في جِسْمِهِ وَثِيابِهِ.
dialogue.tr: tadʿū taʿālīmu l-islāmi kulla muslimin ilā an yakūna naẓīfan ṭāhiran fī jismihi wathībih
dialogue.en: The teachings of Islam call every Muslim to be clean and pure in his body and clothes.
dialogue.ur: Islam ki taleemat har musalman ko jism aur kapdon mein saaf aur paak rehne ki dawat deti hain.

dialogue.ar: قالَ تَعالى: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla taʿālā: inna llāha yuḥibbu t-tawwābīna wa-yuḥibbu l-mutaṭahhirīn
dialogue.en: Allah the Exalted said: Indeed Allah loves those who repent and loves those who purify themselves.
dialogue.ur: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: beshak Allah tauba karne walon aur paak rehne walon se mohabbat karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَجَعَلَ اللهُ الماءَ سَبَباً لِلطَّهارَةِ، فَهُوَ يُنَظِّفُ الجِسْمَ وَالثَّوْبَ.
dialogue.tr: wajaʿala llāh l-māʾa sababan liṭ-ṭahāra, fahuwa yunaẓẓifu l-jisma wath-thawb
dialogue.en: Allah made water a means of purification, for it cleans the body and the garment.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne paani ko paaki ka zariya banaya, kyunke wo jism aur kapde ko saaf karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَهْتَمُّ المُسْلِمُ بِنَظافَةِ جَسَدِهِ وَثِيابِهِ وَمَسْكَنِهِ وَالبيئَةِ مِنْ حَوْلِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wayahtammu al-muslimu binaẓāfati jasadihi wathībihi wamaskanihi wal-bīʾati min ḥawlih
dialogue.en: A Muslim cares about the cleanliness of his body, his clothes, his home and the surroundings around him.
dialogue.ur: Musalman apne jism, kapdon, ghar aur apne ird-gird ke mahaul ki safai ka khayal rakhta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالوُضوءُ مِنْ أَوْضَحِ صُوَرِ ذَلِكَ؛ فَالمُسْلِمُ يَتَوَضَّأُ لِلصَّلَواتِ الخَمْسِ في اليَوْمِ وَاللَّيْلَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-wuḍūʾu min awḍaḥi ṣuwari dhālika fal-muslimu yatawaḍḍaʾu liṣ-ṣalawti l-khamsi fī l-yawmi wal-layla
dialogue.en: Wudu is one of the clearest forms of that; a Muslim makes wudu for the five prayers in the day and night.
dialogue.ur: Wuzu iski sab se wazeh soorton mein se hai; musalman din raat ki paanch namazon ke liye wuzu karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَتَوَضَّأُ كَذَلِكَ قَبْلَ الطَّوافِ بِالكَعْبَةِ، وَقَدْ يَتَوَضَّأُ لِقِراءَةِ القُرْآنِ.
dialogue.tr: wayatawaḍḍaʾu kadhalika qabla ṭ-ṭawfi bil-kaʿba, waqad yatawaḍḍaʾu liqirāʾati l-qurʾān
dialogue.en: He also makes wudu before circling the Kaaba, and he may make wudu to recite the Quran.
dialogue.ur: Wo Kaabe ke tawaf se pehle bhi wuzu karta hai, aur Quran parhne ke liye bhi wuzu kar sakta hai.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا طَريقَةُ الوُضوءِ فَيَغْسِلُ فيها المُتَوَضِّئُ وَجْهَهُ وَيَدَيْهِ وَرِجْلَيْهِ، وَيَمْسَحُ رَأْسَهُ.
dialogue.tr: ammā ṭarīqatu l-wuḍūʾi fayaghsilu fīhā l-mutawaḍḍiʾu wajhahu wayadayhi warijlayh, wayamsaḥu raʾsah
dialogue.en: As for the way of wudu, the one performing it washes his face, his hands and his feet, and wipes his head.
dialogue.ur: Wuzu ka tareeqa ye hai ke wuzu karne wala apna chehra, haath aur paon dhota hai aur sar ka masah karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهَكَذا يُزيلُ الوُضوءُ الغُبارَ وَالأَوْساخَ عَنِ الجِسْمِ، وَيَتَكَرَّرُ مَرّاتٍ في اليَوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: wahakadhā yuzīlu l-wuḍūʾu l-ghubāra wal-awsākha ʿani l-jism, wayatakarraru marrātin fī l-yawm
dialogue.en: In this way wudu removes dust and dirt from the body, and it is repeated several times a day.
dialogue.ur: Is tarah wuzu jism se gard o ghubar aur gandagi door karta hai, aur din mein kai baar dohraya jata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيُضيفُ المُسْلِمُ إِلى الوُضوءِ الغُسْلَ، وَهُوَ تَنْظيفُ الجِسْمِ كُلِّهِ بِالماءِ.
dialogue.tr: wayuḍīfu l-muslimu ilā l-wuḍūʾi l-ghusl, wahuwa tanẓīfu l-jismi kullihi bil-māʾ
dialogue.en: A Muslim adds ghusl to wudu, which is cleaning the whole body with water.
dialogue.ur: Musalman wuzu ke saath ghusl bhi karta hai, yani poore jism ko paani se saaf karna.

dialogue.ar: وَالثَّوْبُ كَالجِسْمِ في ذَلِكَ؛ فَالمُسْلِمُ يُحافِظُ عَلى نَظافَةِ ثِيابِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wath-thawbu kal-jismi fī dhālika fal-muslimu yuḥāfiẓu ʿalā naẓāfati thībih
dialogue.en: The garment is like the body in that; a Muslim keeps his clothes clean.
dialogue.ur: Is mein kapda jism ki tarah hai; musalman apne kapdon ko saaf rakhta hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَ اللهُ تَعالى: ﴿وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla llāh taʿālā wathībaka faṭahhir
dialogue.en: Allah the Most High said: And purify your clothes.
dialogue.ur: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: Aur apne kapdon ko paak rakho.

q.en: How many times a day does a Muslim make wudu for prayer (as in the text)?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Musalman namaz ke liye din mein kitni baar wuzu karta hai?
q.ar: كَمْ مَرَّةً في اليَوْمِ يَتَوَضَّأُ المُسْلِمُ لِلصَّلاةِ (كَما في النَّصِّ)؟

q.en: Which is NOT washed in wudu in the text?
q.ur: Matn mein wuzu mein kaun sa hissa dhone ka zikr nahin?
q.ar: أَيُّ عُضْوٍ لا يُغْسَلُ في الوُضوءِ في النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What does a Muslim add to wudu to clean the whole body?
q.ur: Poora jism saaf karne ke liye Musalman wuzu ke saath kya karta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يُضيفُ المُسْلِمُ إِلى الوُضوءِ لِتَنْظيفِ الجِسْمِ كُلِّهِ؟

q.ur: «الطَّهارَةُ» ka matlab:

q.en: What did Allah make a means of purification?
q.ur: Allah ne kis cheez ko paaki ka zariya banaya?

intro.en: The dual means exactly two. Add ـانِ (alif + nūn) to the noun in the nominative (قَلَمانِ), and ـيْنِ (yā' + nūn) in the accusative or genitive (قَلَمَيْنِ). Example: الطّالِبانِ حَضَرا (two students came) / قابَلْتُ الصَّديقَيْنِ (I met the two friends).
intro.ur: Muthanna (tasniya) matlab bilkul do. Marfu halat mein ـانِ lagta hai (قَلَمانِ) aur mansub ya majroor mein ـيْنِ (قَلَمَيْنِ). Misaal: الطّالِبانِ حَضَرا (do talib-e-ilm aaye) / قابَلْتُ الصَّديقَيْنِ (main do doston se mila).
intro.ar: المُثَنّى يَدُلُّ عَلى اثْنَيْنِ بِالضَّبْطِ. نُضيفُ «ـانِ» إِلى الاسْمِ في حالَةِ الرَّفْعِ (قَلَمانِ)، وَ«ـيْنِ» في حالَتَيِ النَّصْبِ وَالجَرِّ (قَلَمَيْنِ). مِثالٌ: الطّالِبانِ حَضَرا، وَقابَلْتُ الصَّديقَيْنِ.

q.en: What is the dual of «قَلَم» in the nominative?
q.ur: «قَلَم» ka marfu tasniya kya hai?
Mukammal karein: قابَلْتُ الصَّديق___

q.en: Which one is a dual noun?
q.ur: Inmein se kaun sa tasniya hai?
Tasniya kis ke liye aata hai?
«عَيْنانِ» ka matlab:

intro.en: A family decides to eat dinner out at a fast-food restaurant, but afterwards everyone feels sick. Learn useful phrases: «أَشْعُرُ بِآلام» (I feel pains) and «لَنْ أَتَناوَلَ» (I will never eat).
intro.ur: Ek khandan raat ka khana bahar fast food mein khane ka faisla karta hai, lekin baad mein sab ki tabiyat kharab ho jati hai. Mufeed jumle seekhein: «أَشْعُرُ بِآلام» (mujhe dard ho raha hai) aur «لَنْ أَتَناوَلَ» (main hargiz nahin khaunga).
intro.ar: تَقَرِّرُ أُسْرَةٌ أَنْ تَتَعَشّى في مَطْعَمِ وَجَباتٍ سَريعَةٍ، وَبَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَشْعُرُ الجَميعُ بِالمَرَضِ. تَعَلَّمْ عِباراتٍ مُفيدَةً: «أَشْعُرُ بِآلامٍ» وَ«لَنْ أَتَناوَلَ».

dialogue.ar: ما رَأْيُكُمْ أَنْ نَتَناوَلَ العَشاءَ اللَّيْلَةَ في مَطْعَمٍ افْتُتِحَ قَريباً؟
dialogue.tr: mā raʾyukum an natanāwala l-ʿashāʾa l-laylata fī maṭʿamin ftutiḥa qarīban?
dialogue.en: What do you think about having dinner tonight at a restaurant that opened recently?
dialogue.ur: Aap ki kya raye hai, aaj raat ka khana us restaurant mein khayen jo haal hi mein khula hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ نَعَمْ! أُحِبُّ الأَكْلاتِ السَّريعَةَ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: naʿam naʿam uḥibbu al-aklāti s-sarīʿata kathīran
dialogue.en: Yes, yes! I love fast food very much.
dialogue.ur: Haan haan! Mujhe fast food bohat pasand hai.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أُفَضِّلُ طَعامَ البَيْتِ؛ فَهُوَ لَذيذٌ وَصِحِّيٌّ وَنَظيفٌ.
dialogue.tr: anā ufaḍḍilu ṭaʿāma l-bayt fahuwa ladhīdhun waṣiḥḥiyyun wanaẓīf
dialogue.en: I prefer home food; it is tasty, healthy and clean.
dialogue.ur: Main ghar ka khana behtar samajhti hoon; wo lazeez, sehatmand aur saaf hota hai.

dialogue.ar: سَنُجَرِّبُ المَطْعَمَ اللَّيْلَةَ، وَغَداً نَأْكُلُ في البَيْتِ.
dialogue.tr: sanujarribu l-maṭʿama l-layla, waghadan naʾkulu fī l-bayt
dialogue.en: We will try the restaurant tonight, and tomorrow we will eat at home.
dialogue.ur: Aaj raat hum restaurant aazmayenge, aur kal ghar par khayenge.

dialogue.ar: حَسَناً، هَيّا بِنا نَذْهَبْ.
dialogue.tr: ḥasanan, hayyā binā nadhhab
dialogue.en: All right, let us go.
dialogue.ur: Theek hai, chalo chalte hain.

dialogue.ar: يا أَبي، أَشْعُرُ بِآلامٍ في بَطْني.
dialogue.tr: yā abī, ashʿuru biʾālāmin fī baṭnī
dialogue.en: Father, I feel pains in my stomach.
dialogue.ur: Abbu, mujhe pet mein dard mehsoos ho raha hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا كَذَلِكَ يا رَهَفُ! بَطْني يُؤْلِمُني بِشِدَّةٍ، آهٍ!
dialogue.tr: waʾanā kadhalika yā rahaf baṭnī yuʾlimunī bishidda, ʾāh
dialogue.en: Me too, Rahaf! My stomach hurts badly, ouch!
dialogue.ur: Mujhe bhi Rahaf! Mera pet bohat shiddat se dard kar raha hai, aah!

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا أَشْعُرُ بِالأَلَمِ نَفْسِهِ.
dialogue.tr: waʾanā ashʿuru bil-alami nafsih
dialogue.en: And I feel the same pain.
dialogue.ur: Aur mujhe bhi wahi dard ho raha hai.

dialogue.ar: سَأَدْعو سَيّارَةَ الإِسْعافِ الآنَ؛ فَهَذِهِ الأَعْراضُ تُشْبِهُ التَّسَمُّمَ.
dialogue.tr: saʾadʿū sayyārata l-isʿāfi l-ʾān fahadhihi l-aʿrāḍu tushbihu t-tasamum
dialogue.en: I will call an ambulance now; these symptoms look like food poisoning.
dialogue.ur: Main abhi ambulance bulati hoon; ye alamaat khane ki zehr-khurani jaisi lagti hain.

dialogue.ar: لاحَظْتُ أَنَّ العُمّالَ لَمْ يَغْسِلوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ، وَأَنَّ المَكانَ غَيْرُ نَظيفٍ.
dialogue.tr: lāḥaẓtu anna al-ʿummāla lam yaghsilū aydiyahum, waʾanna al-makāna ghayru naẓīf
dialogue.en: I noticed that the workers did not wash their hands and that the place was not clean.
dialogue.ur: Maine dekha ke karigaron ne haath nahin dhoye aur jagah saaf nahin thi.

dialogue.ar: اِنْتَبَهْتُ إِلى المائِدَةِ؛ عَلَيْها بَقايا طَعامٍ قَديمٍ، وَكَذَلِكَ الأَطْباقُ وَالأَكْوابُ مُتَّسِخَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: intabahtu ilā l-māʾida ʿalayhā baqāī ṭaʿāmin qadīm, wakadhalika l-aṭbāqu wal-akwbu muttasikha
dialogue.en: I paid attention to the table; it had leftovers of old food, and likewise the plates and cups were dirty.
dialogue.ur: Maine mez dekhi; us par purane khane ke bachay hue the, aur isi tarah plate aur gilaas bhi ganday the.

dialogue.ar: لَنْ أَتَناوَلَ طَعاماً مِنْ مَطْعَمٍ غَيْرِ نَظيفٍ بَعْدَ اليَوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: lan atanāwala ṭaʿāman min maṭʿamin ghayri naẓīfin baʿda l-yawm
dialogue.en: I will never eat food from a dirty restaurant after today.
dialogue.ur: Aaj ke baad main kisi ganday restaurant ka khana kabhi nahin khaungi.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا لَنْ أَنْسى هَذا الدَّرْسَ أَبَداً.
dialogue.tr: waʾanā lan ansā hādhā d-darsa abadan
dialogue.en: And I will never forget this lesson.
dialogue.ur: Aur main ye sabaq kabhi nahin bhoolunga.

dialogue.ar: ها قَدْ وَصَلَتْ سَيّارَةُ الإِسْعافِ، تَحَمَّلوا قَليلاً يا أَحِبّائي.
dialogue.tr: hā qad waṣalat sayyāratu l-isʿāf, taḥammalū qalīlan yā aḥibbāʾī
dialogue.en: Here, the ambulance has arrived; bear it a little, my loved ones.
dialogue.ur: Lo ambulance pahunch gayi, zara sabr karo mere pyaro.

q.en: Where did the family feel pain?
q.ur: Khandan ko kahan dard hua?

q.en: What did the mother think caused it?
q.ur: Ammi ke khayal mein iski wajah kya thi?

q.en: Which did the mother say was better, home food or restaurant food?
q.ur: Ammi ne kaha ke behtar kya hai, ghar ka khana ya restaurant ka?
q.ar: ماذا فَضَّلَتِ الأُمُّ: طَعامَ البَيْتِ أَمْ طَعامَ المَطْعَمِ؟

q.ur: «لَذيذٌ» ka matlab?
"Ambulance" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني المَرْكَبَةَ الَّتي تَنْقُلُ المَرْضى؟

intro.en: Learn the question words and what each one asks about: مَنْ (who), ما / ماذا (what), أَيْنَ (where), مَتى (when), لِماذا (why), كَيْفَ (how), كَمْ (how many), أَيّ (which), هَلْ / أَ (yes/no questions).
intro.ur: Sawal ke alfaz aur unka istemal seekhein: مَنْ (kaun), ما / ماذا (kya), أَيْنَ (kahan), مَتى (kab), لِماذا (kyun), كَيْفَ (kaise), كَمْ (kitna), أَيّ (kaun sa), هَلْ / أَ (haan ya nahin wale sawal).
intro.ar: تَعَلَّمْ أَدَواتِ الاسْتِفْهامِ وَما تَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ كُلُّ أَداةٍ: مَنْ لِلشَّخْصِ، ما وَماذا لِلشَّيْءِ، أَيْنَ لِلْمَكانِ، مَتى لِلزَّمانِ، لِماذا لِلسَّبَبِ، كَيْفَ لِلْحالِ، كَمْ لِلْعَدَدِ، أَيّ لِلتَّعْيينِ، وَهَلْ وَالهَمْزَةُ لِسُؤالٍ جَوابُهُ نَعَمْ أَوْ لا.

q.en: Which question word asks about a place?
q.ur: Jagah ke liye kaun sa sawali lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةِ اسْتِفْهامٍ نَسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ المَكانِ؟

q.ur: Waqt ke liye kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةِ اسْتِفْهامٍ نَسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ الزَّمانِ؟

q.ur: Wajah poochne ke liye kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةِ اسْتِفْهامٍ نَسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ السَّبَبِ؟

q.ur: «كَمْ طِفْلاً لَكَ؟» kis ke baare mein hai?
«هَلْ تُحِبُّ الشّايَ؟» ka jawab hota hai:

title.ur: Sunna aur khane ke baare mein baat

intro.en: Listen to a text about two brothers, Imad and Alaa, who differ in clothes, manners and cleanliness, then choose the right answers. After that, talk with a partner about where and when you eat and whether you like fast food.
intro.ur: Do bhaiyon Imad aur Alaa ke baare mein ek matn suniye jo libaas, akhlaq aur safai mein mukhtalif hain, phir sahi jawab chuniye. Uske baad saathi se baat karein ke aap kahan aur kab khana khate hain aur kya fast food pasand hai.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى نَصٍّ عَنْ أَخَوَيْنِ، عِمادٍ وَعَلاءٍ، يَخْتَلِفانِ في اللِّباسِ وَالأَخْلاقِ وَالنَّظافَةِ، ثُمَّ اخْتَرِ الإِجاباتِ الصَّحيحَةَ. بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ تَحَدَّثْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَنْ مَكانِ الأَكْلِ وَوَقْتِهِ وَهَلْ تُحِبُّ الوَجَباتِ السَّريعَةَ.

q.ur: «يُفَضِّلُ» ka matlab:
«طَيِّبُ الكَلامِ» kaisa shakhs hai?
«أَخَوانِ» hai:
«الأَخْلاقُ» ka matlab:

intro.en: A reading about private cleanliness (body, clothes, food, home) and public cleanliness (streets and gardens), and who is responsible for each. It also mentions the hadith about removing harm from the road.
intro.ur: Ek matn jis mein zaati safai (jism, kapde, khana, ghar) aur aam safai (sadkein aur baagh) aur har ek ki zimmedari ka bayan hai. Rasool Allah ﷺ ke us farman ka bhi zikr hai jis mein raste se takleef-deh cheez hatane ko sadaqa kaha gaya.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ النَّظافَةِ الخاصَّةِ (الجِسْمِ وَالثِّيابِ وَالطَّعامِ وَالبَيْتِ) وَالنَّظافَةِ العامَّةِ (الشَّوارِعِ وَالحَدائِقِ) وَمَنِ المَسْؤولُ عَنْ كُلٍّ مِنْهُما. وَفيهِ حَديثُ إِماطَةِ الأَذى عَنِ الطَّريقِ.

dialogue.ar: نَتَحَدَّثُ هُنا عَنْ نَوْعَيْنِ مِنَ النَّظافَةِ: الخاصَّةِ وَالعامَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: nataḥaddathu hunā ʿan nawʿayni mina n-naẓāfa al-khāṣṣati wal-ʿāmma
dialogue.en: Here we speak about two kinds of cleanliness: private and public.
dialogue.ur: Yahan hum safai ki do qismon par baat karte hain: nijji aur aam.

dialogue.ar: فَالنَّظافَةُ الخاصَّةُ تَتَعَلَّقُ بِحَياةِ الفَرْدِ: بَدَنِهِ وَمَلْبَسِهِ وَغِذائِهِ وَمَنْزِلِهِ.
dialogue.tr: fan-naẓāfatu l-khāṣṣatu tataʿallaqu biḥayti l-fard badanihi wamalbasihi waghidhāʾihi wamanzilih
dialogue.en: Private cleanliness relates to the life of the individual: his body, clothing, food and dwelling.
dialogue.ur: Nijji safai fard ki zindagi se talluq rakhti hai: uska badan, libaas, khurak aur rehaish.

dialogue.ar: وَالعامَّةُ هِيَ نَظافَةُ ما يَشْتَرِكُ فيهِ النّاسُ: الشَّوارِعُ وَالحَدائِقُ وَالأَسْواقُ.
dialogue.tr: wal-ʿāmmatu hiya naẓāfatu mā yashtariku fīhi n-nās ash-shawriʿu wal-ḥadāʾiqu wal-aswq
dialogue.en: The public one is the cleanliness of what people share: streets, gardens and markets.
dialogue.ur: Aam safai un jagahon ki safai hai jin mein log shareek hain: sarkein, baghaat aur bazaar.

dialogue.ar: وَكُلُّ فَرْدٍ مَسْؤولٌ عَنْ نَظافَتِهِ الخاصَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: wakullu fardin masʾūlun ʿan naẓāfatihi l-khāṣṣa
dialogue.en: Every individual is responsible for his private cleanliness.
dialogue.ur: Har fard apni nijji safai ka zimmedar hai.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا النَّظافَةُ العامَّةُ فَالمَسْؤولِيَّةُ فيها مُشْتَرَكَةٌ بَيْنَ الأَفْرادِ وَالحُكوماتِ.
dialogue.tr: ammā n-naẓāfatu l-ʿāmmatu fal-masʾūliyyatu fīhā mushtarakatun bayna l-afrādi wal-ḥukūmāt
dialogue.en: As for public cleanliness, the responsibility in it is shared between individuals and governments.
dialogue.ur: Rahi aam safai, to us mein zimmedari afrad aur hukumaton ke darmiyan mushtarak hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتُعَدُّ النَّظافَةُ اليَوْمَ مِقْياساً لِتَقَدُّمِ الأُمَمِ.
dialogue.tr: watuʿaddu an-naẓāfatu l-yawma miqysan litaqaddumi l-umam
dialogue.en: Today cleanliness is counted as a measure of the progress of nations.
dialogue.ur: Aaj safai ko qaumon ki taraqqi ka paimana mana jata hai.

dialogue.ar: فَالدَّوْلَةُ الَّتي يَعْتَني أَهْلُها وَحُكومَتُها بِالنَّظافَةِ دَوْلَةٌ مُتَحَضِّرَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: fad-dawlatu llatī yaʿtanī ahluhā waḥukūmatuhā bin-naẓāfati dawlatun mutaḥaḍḍira
dialogue.en: The country whose people and government look after cleanliness is a civilised country.
dialogue.ur: Jis mulk ke log aur hukumat safai ka khayal rakhte hain wo mutamaddin mulk hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالدَّوْلَةُ الَّتي يُهْمِلونَ فيها النَّظافَةَ دَوْلَةٌ مُتَخَلِّفَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: wad-dawlatu llatī yuhmilūna fīhā n-naẓāfata dawlatun mutakhallifa
dialogue.en: The country in which they neglect cleanliness is a backward country.
dialogue.ur: Jis mulk mein safai ko nazarandaz kiya jaye wo pasmanda mulk hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلِهَذا تَصْرِفُ حُكوماتٌ كَثيرَةٌ مَبالِغَ كَبيرَةً لِتَنْظيفِ المُدُنِ.
dialogue.tr: walihadhā taṣrifu ḥukūmātun kathīratun mabāligha kabīratan litanẓīfi l-mudun
dialogue.en: For this reason many governments spend large sums to clean the cities.
dialogue.ur: Isi liye bohat si hukumatein shehron ki safai par bari raqmein kharch karti hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالمُواطِنُ الصّالِحُ يُساعِدُ دَوْلَتَهُ، فَيَرْمي النُّفاياتِ في الحاوِياتِ وَلا يَرْميها في الطَّريقِ.
dialogue.tr: wal-mūṭinu ṣ-ṣāliḥu yusāʿidu dawlatah, fayarmī n-nufāīti fī l-ḥāwīti walā yarmīhā fī ṭ-ṭarīq
dialogue.en: The good citizen helps his state: he throws the rubbish into the bins and does not throw it in the road.
dialogue.ur: Naik shehri apni riyasat ki madad karta hai: wo kooda dustbin mein daalta hai aur raste mein nahin phenkta.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ قالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: «إِماطَةُ الأَذى عَنِ الطَّريقِ صَدَقَةٌ».
dialogue.tr: waqad qāla n-nabiyu imāṭatu l-adhā ʿani ṭ-ṭarīqi ṣadaqa
dialogue.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: Removing harm from the road is charity.
dialogue.ur: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: Raste se takleef dene wali cheez hatana sadqa hai.

title.en: Dropping the nūn in a possessive phrase

intro.en: When the dual or sound masculine plural is followed by the thing it belongs to (iḍāfa), the final ن is dropped. Example: القَلَمانِ جَديدانِ (the two pens are new) but قَلَما سَعيدٍ (Saeed's two pens); مُسْلِمونَ مِنَ الهِنْدِ but مُسْلِمو الهِنْدِ (Muslims of India).
intro.ur: Jab muthanna ya jama muzakkar salim ke baad mudaf-ilaih aaye (izafat) to aakhri ن gir jata hai. Misaal: القَلَمانِ جَديدانِ (do qalam naye hain) lekin قَلَما سَعيدٍ (Saeed ke do qalam); مُسْلِمونَ مِنَ الهِنْدِ lekin مُسْلِمو الهِنْدِ (Hind ke Musalman).
intro.ar: إِذا جاءَ بَعْدَ المُثَنّى أَوْ جَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ ما يُضافُ إِلَيْهِ تُحْذَفُ النّونُ الأَخيرَةُ. مِثالٌ: القَلَمانِ جَديدانِ، وَلَكِنْ: قَلَما سَعيدٍ. مُسْلِمونَ مِنَ الهِنْدِ، وَلَكِنْ: مُسْلِمو الهِنْدِ.

intro.en: Practise writing short texts. Topics: «كَيْفَ أُحافِظُ عَلى نَظافَةِ مَسْكَني وَبَيْتي» (How I keep my home clean), retelling the fast-food dialogue as a story, «النَّظافَةُ في الإِسْلامِ» (Cleanliness in Islam), and a paragraph comparing private and public cleanliness.
intro.ur: Chhote matn likhne ki mashq. Mauzu: «كَيْفَ أُحافِظُ عَلى نَظافَةِ مَسْكَني وَبَيْتي» (main apne ghar ki safai kaise rakhta hoon), fast food wale mukaalme ko kahani ki shakal mein likhna, «النَّظافَةُ في الإِسْلامِ» (Islam mein safai), aur zaati aur aam safai ka muqabla.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى كِتابَةِ نُصوصٍ قَصيرَةٍ. مِنَ المَوْضوعاتِ: «كَيْفَ أُحافِظُ عَلى نَظافَةِ مَسْكَني وَبَيْتي»، وَإِعادَةُ حِوارِ الوَجَباتِ السَّريعَةِ عَلى شَكْلِ قِصَّةٍ، وَ«النَّظافَةُ في الإِسْلامِ»، وَفَقْرَةٌ تُقارِنُ بَيْنَ النَّظافَةِ الخاصَّةِ وَالعامَّةِ.

intro.en: Practise Ruq'ah calligraphy with the verse «قُلْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبِعوني يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ». Spelling rule: the ة (tā' marbūṭa) becomes ت before a pronoun or the dual (حَقيبَة → حَقيبَتي، سَيّارَة → سَيّارَتانِ) and is dropped before the plural ending ـات (فاطِمَة → فاطِمات).
intro.ur: Ruqah khat ki mashq, ayat «قُلْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبِعوني يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ» ke saath. Imla ka qaida: ة (ta marbuta) zameer ya tasniya se pehle ت ban jati hai (حَقيبَة → حَقيبَتي، سَيّارَة → سَيّارَتانِ) aur jama ـات se pehle gir jati hai (فاطِمَة → فاطِمات).
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى خَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ بِالآيَةِ: «قُلْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبِعوني يُحْبِبْكُمُ اللَّهُ». قاعِدَةُ الإِمْلاءِ: تَصيرُ التّاءُ المَرْبوطَةُ تاءً مَبْسوطَةً قَبْلَ الضَّميرِ وَالمُثَنّى (حَقيبَتي، سَيّارَتانِ)، وَتُحْذَفُ قَبْلَ نِهايَةِ جَمْعِ المُؤَنَّثِ «ـات» (فاطِمات).

intro.en: A review of Units 9 and 10: reading an email message, multiple choice questions, opposites, synonyms, grammar choices (e.g. سَيّارَتانِ, بِمَ) and a short reading about a family that ate out and got sick.
intro.ur: Unit 9 aur 10 ki dohrai: email ka paigham parhna, multiple choice sawal, mutazaad aur hum-maani alfaz, grammar ke intikhabat (jaise سَيّارَتانِ، بِمَ) aur ek khandan ke bahar khane se beemar hone ka chhota matn.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلْوَحْدَتَيْنِ التّاسِعَةِ وَالعاشِرَةِ: قِراءَةُ رِسالَةٍ إِلِكْتْرونِيَّةٍ، وَأَسْئِلَةُ الاخْتِيارِ مِنْ مُتَعَدِّدٍ، وَالأَضْدادُ وَالمُرادِفاتُ، وَاخْتِيارُ الصَّوابِ في القَواعِدِ، وَنَصٌّ قَصيرٌ عَنْ أُسْرَةٍ تَناوَلَتِ العَشاءَ في مَطْعَمٍ فَمَرِضَتْ.

dialogue.ar: يا خالِدُ، اُكْتُبْ رِسالَةً قَصيرَةً لِلْمُوَظَّفِ إِبْراهيمَ في جُدَّةَ، وَأَرْسِلْها اليَوْمَ بِالبَريدِ الإِلِكْتِرونِيِّ.
dialogue.tr: yā khālid, uktub risālatan qaṣīratan lil-muwaẓẓafi ibrāhīma fī judda, waʾarsilhā l-yawma bil-barīdi l-iliktirūniyy
dialogue.en: Khalid, write a short message to the employee Ibrahim in Jeddah, and send it today by e-mail.
dialogue.ur: Khalid, Jeddah ke mulazim Ibrahim ko ek mukhtasar khat likho aur aaj hi e-mail se bhej do.

dialogue.ar: وَقُلْ لَهُ: نَرْجو أَنْ تَأْتِيَ إِلى مَكْتَبِنا في الكُوَيْتِ بَعْدَ العيدِ بِأُسْبوعٍ.
dialogue.tr: waqul lah narjū an taʾtiya ilā maktabinā fī l-kuwayti baʿda l-ʿīdi biʾusbūʿ
dialogue.en: And tell him: we hope you will come to our office in Kuwait a week after Eid.
dialogue.ur: Aur use kaho: hum chahte hain ke aap Eid ke ek hafte baad Kuwait mein hamare daftar aayein.

dialogue.ar: نُريدُ بِهَذا رَبْطَ شَرِكَتِنا في مِصْرَ بِالشَّبَكَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ، لِتَصيرَ مِثْلَ فَرْعِنا في عُمانَ.
dialogue.tr: nurīdu bihadhā rabṭa sharikatinā fī miṣra bish-shabakati d-dawliya, litaṣīra mithla farʿinā fī ʿumān
dialogue.en: By this we want to connect our company in Egypt to the internet, so that it becomes like our branch in Oman.
dialogue.ur: Is se hum Misr mein apni company ko internet se jodna chahte hain, taake wo Oman ki hamari shaakh jaisi ho jaye.
